note: Source: Coventry City Council rubbish and recycling pages (coventry.gov.uk), checked 19 Nov 2026. Council rules can change; check the council before relying on this for a decision. Status: verified = stated on the council page; needs_check = not stated, so check the council.

bins.name: General waste (green-lidded bin, fortnightly)
bins.accepts: Black bags, general waste, nappies, cling film, plant pots, broken ceramics, drinking glasses, shredded paper. Not batteries, vapes or electrical items.

bins.name: Recycling (blue-lidded bin, fortnightly)
bins.accepts: Cans, glass bottles and jars, paper, card, cartons, plastic milk bottles, cleaning bottles, plastic trays, yoghurt pots. No bags or film.

bins.name: Food waste (caddy, weekly)
bins.accepts: Food including meat, bones, dairy, peelings and teabags. No liquids, packaging or plastic bags.

bins.name: Drop-off point (tip or retailer)
bins.accepts: Batteries and car batteries (retailers or tip), hard plastic trays (tip), and other items the council says to take to the tip

items.name: Paper coffee cup
items.reason: Drinks cups cannot currently be recycled in Coventry, so they go in the green-lidded general waste bin.

items.name: Greasy pizza box
items.reason: Boxes contaminated with pizza or grease cannot be recycled in Coventry. Put them in the green-lidded general waste bin.

items.name: Plastic yoghurt pot
items.reason: Wash it first, then put it in the blue-lidded recycling bin.

items.name: Glass jar
items.reason: Glass goes in the blue-lidded recycling bin. The council page does not give rinsing or lid rules for glass jars, so rinse and empty them as a precaution.

items.name: Batteries
items.reason: Batteries are not allowed in any household bin in Coventry. Take them to a retailer collection point or the tip.

items.name: Clean pizza box
items.reason: The council page does not say which bin a clean pizza box goes in. Check the Coventry council site or the Your Rubbish app.

items.name: Plastic tub (not yoghurt pot)
items.reason: The council page does not list plastic tubs separately. Check the Coventry council site or the Your Rubbish app.

conflicts_to_resolve: Food waste: the household bins page says food goes in a caddy (weekly) and the A-Z page says food goes in the brown-lidded bin. Likely the caddy is emptied into the brown bin, but confirm.
Hard plastic trays: the household bins page lists plastic trays for the blue bin, while the A-Z page says hard plastic trays go to the tip. Confirm before using.
